//: Performance budgets from the approved architecture, expressed as data so
the gates are declarative and a budget change is a reviewable one-line diff.
These are PASS/FAIL, not aspirations. A milestone that breaches one is not
done. Enforced from M1 onward so a regression is caught by the commit that
causes it, rather than by an audit at the end when the cause is buried.
computeMs: the heavy derived pipeline (backtest + current momentum) for a
universe of that size. 250 is the Smallcap 250 case and the binding one.
If it is breached, the escalation is the Web Worker implementation behind
the compute scheduler — a configuration change, not a refactor.
bundleKb: gzipped, per chunk. The charts chunk is deliberately separate:
it is the largest dependency and is not needed to paint the answer, so it
must stay out of the initial payload.

compute.//: Measured on the reference machine. Treat as a regression detector first and an absolute limit second.

bundle.//: initialKbGzip counts only eagerChunks. Anything else is lazily loaded and does not affect first paint — counting it would make every new lazy route look like a regression, which is exactly backwards.
